d001.note: p053 l.10 at 1000 dpi: the comma touches the alif of اهدني, with the same tight gap as ن|، and no word space after it (the word gaps on the line are much wider). Kept as printed, following the earlier precedent for a missing space after punctuation (أسماؤه.وكذلك, رحمه الله .كما).

d002.note: p054 l.3 at 1500 dpi: مغفرة has a clear fatha over the fa and no kasra under it (A is right). رضوانا has one single fatha stroke over the nun, not the double tanween stroke seen on وعافيةً/ومغفرةً beside it (B is right). Both are print slips, kept as printed.

d003.note: p056 l.11 at 1800 dpi: الإجابة has only the hamza under the alif and no kasra stroke, unlike إِنِّي on the same page. A is right, as printed.

extra_edits.note: p056 l.9 at 2400 dpi: the waw of عدوا has only the two parallel tanween strokes and no shadda (compare ضالِّين/مضلِّين on the same line, where the shadda is clear). Both keyers added a shadda that is not printed.
